thread:
Anna: Heads-up — rolling runtime v2.3 to prod in ~10m (22:00 PT). Can someone own quick post-deploy checks? Checklist: 1) /health -> 200, 2) embedding route p95 < 250ms, 3) token-cost sanity, 4) no error-rate spike. I’ll start canary at +0.
Mike: I’ll drive the deploy and watch first 15m. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 5m holds. Tagging @Jess and @Sam for metrics/rollback.
Jess: On it — I’ll monitor latency + error panels. Alerts set: `prod.embedding.p95`, `prod.5xx.rate > 0.5%`. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/board/embeddings
Sam: Oncall available. If we need rollback run `kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime --to-revision=42` and notify infra.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 2119990060 — 5% traffic. Triggered smoke suite: `scripts/smoke/check_endpoints.sh`.
Anna: Quick smoke from canary host: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/health | jq .status` -> "ok". Ran embedding sniff: p95 ~210ms.
Mike: Noted a tiny 502 blip at +2m (~5 requests). Observing, no rollback yet.
Jess: Quick triage — 502s correlate with external gateway resets (`upstream reset`). Runtime logs don't show OOMs. No rollback recommended.
Anna: Bumping to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Canary bumped to 25% at 2119990180.
Mike: Metrics look stable at 25% — latency flat, error-rate within baseline. Proceeding to full rollout in ~10m unless anyone objects.
Sam: Ready to execute rollback if needed. :thumbsup:
Anna: Thanks all — I’ll post a short follow-up once rollout completes and cost checks are in.
Mike: Closing loop later with final verification and perf numbers.
